content.text: USER: Repo: /home/lane/MythosMini — a 1,050,241-param byte-level (vocab 257) looped-shared-block transformer trained on fineweb-edu, benchmarked on WikiText-2 byte PPL, BLiMP, ARC-Easy against the Tiny-ML leaderboard (overall = mean of blimp, arc, normalized wiki score; efficiency = overall/log10(params+1) so PARAMETER GROWTH IS PENALIZED only logarithmically — doubling params costs ~5% efficiency but any overall gain counts fully). Current pipeline: procedural Dyck warmup -> 2B-token training (NAdamW, WSD schedule) -> 3-round recursive STM -> benchmark all checkpoints -> SLERP tournament -> SFT instruct phase -> instruct SLERP. Architecture: 4 prelude + 1 shared block looped 2-6x with per-loop LoRA + 4 coda, dim 96, RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU, tied embeddings, DSA-style sparse attention (shared model-level lightning indexer, top-128 keys, 64 local window, FlexAttention short path, chunked long path, …[truncated]
